newsitem.title: USA: ESC Medical seeks to market Derma 20 in US.
newsitem.headline: ESC Medical seeks to market Derma 20 in US.

text.p: ESC Medical Systems Ltd said Wednesday it has filed an application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for clearance to market its Derma 20 laser system in the United States.
Derma 20 is a laser system used for general dermatological applications, including skin resurfacing.
There are about 50 new systems placed outside the United States, the company said.
ESC Medical is based in Yokneam, Israel.
